Python byte comparison: the text from '[verifier]' to EOF is identical to the frozen template task.toml and to staged-task-contract.md:62-75; no CRLF; tomllib shows no extra env keys; no docker_image, no allow_internet. Judge files: tomllib parse of all five task/tests/{gates/render,gates/constraints,scored/functional,scored/polish,scored/visual}/judge.toml [judge] tables gives only judge='claude-code', mode, timeout, isolated, prompt_template (+mcp_servers); no model/reasoning_effort/temperature/weight; grep of tests/*.toml for model/OPENROUTER/ANTHROPIC finds none. Fallback 'claude-code' matches REWARDKIT_JUDGE. test.sh:63-66 refuses to grade (zero reward) if REWARDKIT_JUDGE/MODEL missing, so the model comes only from [verifier.env]. Pinned verifier image: task/tests/Dockerfile (sha256 72998ab8..., byte-identical to template tests/Dockerfile and to manifest input hash) uses tagged bases node:22-bookworm-slim and python:3.12-slim, npm @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, pip harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7; Chromium installed through the pinned @playwright/mcp's bundled playwright CLI; apt unpinned (NOTE per check-dockerfiles.py). COPY . /tests with chmod go-rwx. task.toml/test.sh/judge.toml hashes in the frozen cache match manifest.json inputs. Counterexamples tried: (a) a judge.toml adding model='...' or a drifted [verifier.env] (e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set to a literal key, different model) would be caught -- none present; (b) a conforming task cannot fail this row because the block is template-exact. Note (not a defect): base images are version tags, not digests (node:22 is a major-only tag); this is the template-controlled shared Dockerfile and must not be edited for QC. Risk=true because runtime credentialing is NOT EXERCISED: raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload ... are absent'; the scripted golden run used image hireops-verifier:20261002-permission-repair without a judge. No measured evidence shows the claude-code CLI authenticating to OpenRouter with ${OPENROUTER_API_KEY} and the glm model in this candidate's verifier.
